title: Probability at a binary choice
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine and $C$ a configuration on a fixed input. Suppose its one-step successor from $C$ under choice bit $b$ is $C_b$ for each $b\in\{0,1\}$. For any $T\in\mathbb{N}$ and decidable configuration property $Q$, the probability that $Q$ holds after $T+1$ uniformly chosen steps from $C$ is the average of the probabilities that $Q$ holds after $T$ uniformly chosen steps from $C_1$ and from $C_0$.
hypotheses_covered: For each choice bit, the one-step successor from $C$ is $C_b$
